security_audit.summary: All 18 static alerts are false positives involving expected URLs, protective credential guidance, Markdown fences, a GitHub branch path, or readable Korean text. Two semantic concerns remain: mutable external CLI execution with instruction delegation, and updates spanning unrelated skill installations. No evidence found of credential exfiltration or audit-directed prompt injection in the supplied files; the external CLI implementation was not supplied.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md executes a mutable major-version CLI and treats its output as primary instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions locally, pin an exact reviewed CLI version, verify package integrity, and obtain approval before external package execution.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md recommends an update command covering every coding-agent skill installation.
remediation.suggestion: Remove global updates from the search workflow; require separate user approval and display the affected installations before any scoped update.

content.user_title: Search Coupang Products and Compare Delivery
content.value_statement: Finding suitable Coupang products requires comparing prices, delivery types, and changing availability. This skill guides proxy searches and shortlists candidates against your budget.
actual_capabilities: Search through the documented proxy using a keyword of 2 to 100 characters and a limit of 1 to 10 results.
Separate returned products into Rocket delivery and standard delivery groups using the is_rocket field.
Filter returned candidates by price and compare three to five options against a stated budget.
Summarize returned product links, prices, review counts, ratings, and free-shipping indicators when available.
Report documented proxy errors and include affiliate disclosure with product links.
Guide cart and purchase workflows in compatible CloakBrowser environments, including product verification and explicit approval immediately before ordering.
limitations: Search depends on an external proxy with operator-configured Coupang Partners credentials; no live service test was performed during this audit.
The supplied files provide instructions, not a bundled search engine, browser runtime, vault, or independently verified CLI implementation.
Each query returns at most 10 candidates; prices, stock, and delivery conditions can change before checkout.
Search terms are sent to the configured proxy; shopping actions require compatible browser and vault capabilities.

use_cases.title: Compare Household Purchases
use_cases.description: Shortlist household products within a budget and distinguish Rocket delivery from standard shipping.

use_cases.title: Review Student Essentials
use_cases.description: Compare a few affordable study accessories using returned prices, ratings, and shipping indicators.

use_cases.title: Continue an Assisted Purchase
use_cases.description: Use compatible browser support to verify a selected item, add it to the cart, and request approval before ordering.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Coupang for [product keyword] and show three candidates with prices, delivery types, and product links.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Within a Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [product] under [budget] KRW. Compare up to five returned candidates, separating Rocket delivery from standard delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Focused Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [brand and product] for [personal use]. Compare price, ratings, review counts, and shipping where available. Explain missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: compare several available product attributes

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Approved Purchase
prompt_templates.prompt: In CloakBrowser, verify [selected product] and add [quantity] to my cart. Confirm the exact item and final amount before placing any order.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: supported browser and purchase approval workflow

output: Illustrative comparison only; these are not live search results.
Candidate A: 129,000 KRW; Rocket delivery; free shipping reported.
Candidate B: 139,000 KRW; standard delivery; shipping cost requires verification.
Confirm current prices, availability, and delivery on the product page.
Affiliate disclosure: A commission may be received through Coupang Partners activity.

output_examples.input: Search for desk lamps when the proxy returns upstream_not_configured.
output: Search could not complete because the proxy operator has not configured the required Coupang Partners credentials.
No product prices or availability were verified.
Ask the proxy operator to complete configuration, then retry. Do not send API secrets in chat.

best_practices: Use focused keywords and a clear budget; send only necessary search information to the configured proxy.
Review and approve external CLI execution separately; avoid unrelated installation updates during a search.
Recheck product details before checkout, disclose affiliate links, and obtain explicit approval immediately before placing an order.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys, account passwords, or payment credentials into chat, files, or shell arguments.
Do not use bulk crawling, access-control bypasses, or alternate scraping services when the proxy fails.
Do not treat search prices as guaranteed or submit a purchase without immediate, explicit user approval.

faq.question: Do I need my own Coupang Partners API keys?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow keeps API keys and signing on the proxy server under operator control.

faq.question: Which assistants are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Actual execution also requires the appropriate shell, network access, and runtime capabilities.

faq.question: How many products can one search return?
faq.answer: The documented limit is 1 to 10 results, with 10 as the default. Budget comparison happens after results are returned.

faq.question: Can this skill buy a product automatically?
faq.answer: Supported CloakBrowser environments can continue shopping actions. The workflow requires explicit approval of the exact item and final amount immediately before ordering.

faq.question: Is this an official Coupang tool?
faq.answer: No. The skill disclaims official affiliation and requires a Coupang Partners commission disclosure when presenting product links.

faq.question: What should I review before running the CLI?
faq.answer: The stub runs a mutable external package and recommends broad installation updates. Review the package, prefer an exact reviewed version, and approve updates separately.
